restaurantName: Zhuang Ji Quan Fu Lu Mian Guan
address: 59-3 Hua Lane, Licheng, Quanzhou, China Mainland
bio: For over 40 years, this noodle shop has prided itself on its lor mee, or Fujian-style noodles in thick starchy gravy. In his 70s, the owner still helms the kitchen himself and cooks each order of lor mee in individual portions. You may have to wait for your order, but you won’t be disappointed. For toppings, choose from beef, pork liver, oysters or shrimp. Peanuts and garlic make the gravy nutty and aromatic. Made to order vinegar pork and fish roll are also worth trying....
pageTitle: Zhuang Ji Quan Fu Lu Mian Guan
